justification: Image A shows a bull skull mounted on a wall alongside rows of abstract zigzag/chevron sign clusters and horn-like objects on the floor, while Image B shows a curved bone or shell surface densely engraved with overlapping serrated zigzag bands and a small stylized creature with an eye motif. There is no shared specific iconography: A depicts an installed skull with symbolic markings in a room setting, whereas B depicts continuous jagged pattern engraving covering a curved surface with an embedded figural motif, and the only loose commonality is the generic presence of zigzag lines, which is too universal a motif to indicate any shared tradition.
